lines.text: A seven-minute climb, just to throw an egg.
GTA 6 players found a secret at the top of a huge communications tower.
Up there is a bird's nest full of painted eggs.
Throw one off the edge, and a secret cutscene plays!
It smashes right onto a driver's windscreen.
Reports say it echoes a classic Vice City Easter egg.
A player on X shared the find first.
Outlets disagree on exactly where the tower is, so these are early reports.
Would you do the climb? Comment yes or no!
